caption: The drawing depicts a landscaped outdoor scene with several objects. On the left side, there is a large building with pink walls, green window shutters, and a red chimney. The building has multiple windows, some with arched tops. Several green trees with brown trunks are spread throughout the scene, with three closer to the foreground and a row of smaller trees visible in the background. A small structure resembling a gazebo with a pointed roof and open arches, painted in reddish hues, stands in the middle distance to the right of the center. There is a row of green hedges along the bottom edge of the drawing. A brown pathway or road runs across the foreground, in front of the trees and hedges. In the background, there are faint outlines of blue hills or mountains. Near the right edge, there is a dark brown post with a curved extension. The sky is pale, nearly blending with the light background. The colors used are primarily greens, pinks, browns, and light blues.
title: Schermerhorn Estate
